test_tdi_shift_empty: test TimedeltaIndex.shift on an empty index returns the same empty index
test_tdi_shift_hours: test TimedeltaIndex.shift with integer periods and hourly frequency shifts each element by 3 hours
test_tdi_shift_minutes: test TimedeltaIndex.shift with integer periods and minute frequency shifts each element by 3 minutes
test_tdi_shift_int: test TimedeltaIndex.shift on a TimedeltaIndex with inferred frequency and Hour offset shifts by 1
test_tdi_shift_nonstandard_freq: test TimedeltaIndex.shift with a nonstandard frequency string like '2D 1s' shifts each element accordingly
test_shift_no_freq: test TimedeltaIndex.shift without a frequency raises NullFrequencyError
